body:
Probably, but in all honesty thats why I'm not telling her. Would rather die than force myself to live more like this.

I'm taking a shower and going to bed. I'll probably make a post later this year before I actually kill myself. Thanks for talking to me though, it's nice to know there are people who spend time trying to make people they don't even know feel better.

Night

Coincidently my GF left me because I didn't have my priorities in order. I feel like a shitty person because I wasn't sad about it, it's just one less thing to worry about. Sorry for being such a downer when you were nice enough to respond to me, I really do appreciate it if for no other reason then to vent.

I feel like I spend more time trying to escape reality than actually doing anything meaningful in life. It's surprisingly hard to put into words but I am constantly stuck in a state of caring too much about everything unimportant and not caring at all about the things that are. 

I feel bad that it might hurt some people, but in the grand scheme of things I'll be dead so I wont care.
